top_fix: Give her one named account owner who converts every ask into a dated, written, tracked item and posts the outcome back in the chat — and who sends her page numbers weekly unprompted. The root failure on this account is that we treat acknowledgement as resolution: median reply time is 6 minutes, yet 30 of 47 commitments lapsed, one request has gone 104 days without any human answering it, and Mayson had to relay '@natehei ^^' 17 times because no one owned her. The fix that would have changed everything is mechanical, not attitudinal: no verbal-only fixes, no call without a written write-up, and a weekly unprompted report on her whale, her queue and her revenue — which is exactly the reciprocity she said she was missing on 08-24, three weeks before she stopped talking to us.
